vestigium:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the diagonal sum of a matrix and the maximum row-wise count of adjacent equal pairs in sorted rows of the matrix and its transpose, then prints a formatted case line." vestigium]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> a </REF>: int[][] "The input square matrix."
        <REF> n </REF>: int "The dimension of the square matrix a."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize k to 0. RESULT k]
            [COMMAND Initialize r to 0. RESULT r]
            [COMMAND Initialize c to 0. RESULT c]
            [COMMAND Allocate b as a new n by n int matrix. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1, add a[i][i] to k. RESULT k]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 and j from 0 to n-1, set b[i][j] to a[j][i], transposing a into b. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 to n-1, sort a[i] in ascending order using Arrays.sort. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Initialize repeat to 0. RESULT repeat]
            [COMMAND Initialize count to 0. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 to n-1, for j from 0 to n-2, if a[i][j] equals a[i][j+1] then increment repeat, then evaluate count = Math.max(count, repeat); after the row finishes, if repeat > 0 then reset repeat to 0. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 to n-1, sort b[i] in ascending order using Arrays.sort. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Initialize repeat1 to 0. RESULT repeat1]
            [COMMAND Initialize count1 to 0. RESULT count1]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 to n-1, for j from 0 to n-2, if b[i][j] equals b[i][j+1] then increment repeat1, then evaluate count1 = Math.max(count1, repeat1); after the row finishes, if repeat1 > 0 then reset repeat1 to 0. RESULT count1]
            [COMMAND Set r to count + 1. RESULT r]
            [COMMAND Set c to count1 + 1. RESULT c]
            [COMMAND Initialize counter to 1. RESULT counter]
            [COMMAND Select exactly one final output branch based on whether count and count1 are zero or nonzero. RESULT output_branch]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 is 0 and count is 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print "Case #" + counter + ": " + " " + k + " " + count + " " + count1. RESULT output]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 is not 0 and count is not 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print "Case #" + counter + ": " + " " + k + " " + r + " " + c. RESULT output]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 is 0 and count is not 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print "Case #" + counter + ": " + " " + k + " " + r + " " + count1. RESULT output]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: count1 is not 0 and count is 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print "Case #" + counter + ": " + " " + k + " " + count + " " + c. RESULT output]
            [COMMAND Increment counter by 1. RESULT counter]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
